text:
omar: quick review: banner when a user disables autoscaling on a Dedicated pool. Current text: "Disable autoscaling — you may see increased latency under load." feels blunt. Need clearer outcome + next steps.
maria: agree. Proposal: Title: "Turn off autoscaling" Helper: "Disabling autoscaling will keep capacity fixed. During traffic spikes, requests may queue or slow down." CTA: `Disable autoscaling` + secondary `Learn about scaling options`.
tess: UX nit: users care about billing impact. Maybe add line: "This can reduce costs but may impact performance during spikes." Keep it concise.
ben: Also consider offering an automatic safety fallback: if latency crosses threshold we can temporarily add burst capacity. If we don't support it, state that clearly to avoid false expectations.
omar: product confirmed no auto-burst for disabled pools. Update helper: "During spikes, requests may queue or slow down; we will not add extra capacity automatically."
maria: accessibility: banner should not auto-focus. Add aria-live="polite" and ensure color contrast for caution tone meets AA.
tess: copy variants for testing: 1) Conversational: "Want to save cost? Turn off autoscaling. It keeps capacity fixed and may increase latency during spikes." 2) Direct: "Disabling autoscaling fixes capacity. Expect queued requests under heavy load." I prefer the Direct for clarity.
ben: Error state when toggling fails: "Could not update autoscaling setting. Try again or contact support with error ID {{error_id}}." Keep it short and actionable.
omar: CTA label discussion: `Disable autoscaling` vs `Turn off autoscaling`. Use `Disable` for consistency with setting names elsewhere.
maria: final: go with Title: "Disable autoscaling" Helper: "Disabling autoscaling will fix capacity. During traffic spikes, requests may queue or slow down — we will not add extra capacity automatically. This can lower costs." CTA: `Disable autoscaling` + link `Learn about scaling options`. ben/tess: ack.
designbot: Reminder: update Figma component `settings/dedicated/autoscale-banner` and add copy variants frame.
omar: I'll push copy updates to Figma and tag accessibility for a quick pass. Thanks all.
